LayoutDashboard -> SemanticIcon 'layoutDashboard' color note: the web title icon is `LayoutDashboard className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-400"` (L73) and the empty-state icon `LayoutDashboard className="h-5 w-5"` (L140). lucide has no native renderer; SemanticIcon tone is fixed per name (layoutDashboard -> violet 'DB' glyph), so the text-indigo-400 tint collapses to the icon's intrinsic tone — the same color-tint -> semantic-icon collapse precedent set by AlertFeed (neon-cyan->notifications) and ChargeHistory (neon-green->analytics). Title icon -> size='sm' (web h-3.5≈sm); empty icon -> size='md' (web h-5 w-5≈md). The dashboard-stats semantic intent is preserved.

Closing tags/braces L145-147 accounted for.

Inlined native WidgetStatGrid reproduces the web ./shared contract: empty stats -> EmptyState 'No stats available' (web L45); else resolvedCols = compact ? 1 : cols ?? autoCols(stats.length) (autoCols verbatim: %3->3, %4->4, else 2) mapped to a fixed RN column grid via width styles (cellC1=100%/cellC2=50%/cellC3=33.33%/cellC4=25%) inside a wrapping row with -6/-6/-12 gutter margins + 6/12 cell padding — the web @container grid-cols table (grid-cols-2 baseline, @xs/@sm collapses) has no RN equivalent so it collapses to the resolved fixed count (this widget always calls cols={2}); each cell renders the ported native StatCard with label/value/unit/icon/trend mapped 1:1. The web stat.valueColor -> StatCard className has no native StatCard equivalent and is unused by this widget (no statItem sets it), so it is intentionally dropped (documented).

Inlined native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell subset this widget exercises (loading -> Skeleton placeholder View accessibilityRole progressbar; error -> ported QueryError in a centred padded View; titled header icon+uppercase 11px muted title+DataFreshness; title-less overlay DataFreshness for compact 1x1; web WidgetShell L59-80 pulse-on-change effect ported verbatim with a green glow shadow). This widget never passes error, so that branch is structurally dead but retained for parity with the AlertFeed/ChargeHistory inlined shell.

State/prop names (vehicleId, size, vehicles, id, idStr, stats, fsm, timeline, isCompact, isWide, dashStats, fsmState, transitions, statItems, recentTransitions, updatedAt, isFetching, isStale, isError, isLoading, hasData), API paths ('/dashboard/stats', '/vehicles/{id}/state', '/vehicle-states/timeline?vehicle_id=&days=', '/vehicles'), snake_case query params, all i18n keys (widget.dashboardStats.title/vehicles/trips/sessions/fsmState/active/currentState/recentTransitions/noData), the size.cols<=1 / >=3 breakpoints, the 5-transition slice, and the Math.max freshness merge are all preserved. No SI unit-suffixed field is added — this widget reads only counts (totalVehicles/totalTrips/totalChargingSessions) and FSM state strings, no unit conversion involved. No DOM-only modules, HTML elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or web @/ UI imports remain — only react, react-native primitives (ScrollView/StyleSheet/View), the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText + theme tokens, and the ported parity StatusBadge/StatCard/DataFreshness/QueryError/useDashboardStats/useVehicleStateMachine/useStateTimeline/useVehicles.
